label: Breaking News
method: Breaking treatment based on two independent on-scene community reports plus video from the scene. Halton Police had not yet published a media release as of 7:22 p.m., so unconfirmed outcome details remain explicitly attributed.

fallbackPolicy.followUps: Fresh source updates to archived stories receive a priority bonus; unchanged old stories do not become new again.

sourceNotes.officialPolice: Halton Police public newsroom checked at 7:22 p.m.; no release about this incident was posted at that time.
sourceNotes.community: An on-scene X account reported negotiations, K9 and tactical officers. Reddit photos show the police road closure and emergency response, and a separate Reddit video appears to show a man being taken into custody.
sourceNotes.reddit: Used here as on-scene evidence with explicit attribution. Claims of no injuries or shots fired remain unconfirmed until police corroborate them.
